fields.description: The VM identifier in Atlas (the source of truth).
fields.label: Resource ID

fields.description: Human label, mirrored from the Atlas VM (resource_id is a UUID).
fields.label: Title

fields.description: The cluster (Atlas Instance / region) this VM lives in.
fields.label: Cluster

fields.description: Frappe version the VM was provisioned with — requested at create, resolved to a bench image and echoed back by Atlas (an unbuilt version falls back to the default).
fields.label: Frappe Version

fields.description: Mirrors the Atlas-reported status verbatim (raw VM, or Site/Pilot front-door status for bench/site VMs).
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Pending
Provisioning
Deploying
Running
Paused
Stopped
Failed
Terminated

fields.description: The URL a bench VM is fronted at, reported by Atlas; empty for a non-bench VM.
fields.label: Gateway URL

fields.description: One-click admin sign-in URL Atlas minted after boot; short-lived, regenerated on expiry.
fields.label: Login URL

fields.description: When login_url stops working (Atlas mint time + token TTL).
fields.label: Login URL Expires At

fields.description: Set while a background hardware resize runs; blocks power actions and shows a Resizing state.
fields.label: Resize In Progress

fields.description: When the last reconcile (pull) refreshed this row.
fields.label: Last Synced At

fields.description: occurred_at of the last applied Atlas event; drives last-writer-wins.
fields.label: Last Event At
